title: Start May by Protecting Capacity
teaser: A boundary can preserve energy before overload appears.
message: Write one thing you will intentionally limit this month so your attention has room for what matters.

title: Set a Start Time Not Just a Deadline
teaser: Tasks with vague beginnings are easy to postpone.
message: Give one important task a specific start time today.

title: Ask a More Answerable Question
teaser: Clear questions make useful help easier to give.
message: When asking for help today include the context the problem and the outcome you need.

title: Move One Purchase to a Waiting List
teaser: Not every want needs an immediate decision.
message: Put one nonessential purchase on a waiting list and revisit it later instead of buying today.

title: Mark the Current Version
teaser: Version confusion can create avoidable mistakes.
message: Identify the authoritative copy of one active document and label it clearly.

title: Plan for the Obstacle Too
teaser: Goals are stronger when the plan includes imperfect conditions.
message: Choose one likely obstacle to a current goal and write the response you will use when it appears.

title: Make One Evening Lighter
teaser: Rest does not need to earn its place by becoming productive.
message: Remove one low-priority commitment from an evening this week and leave the time open.

title: Estimate the Recoverable Downside
teaser: Risk becomes easier to judge when it is concrete.
message: For one decision write the worst reasonable outcome and the practical way you would recover from it.

title: Verify Two-Step Sign-In
teaser: Extra verification is only useful when it is actually configured and recoverable.
message: Check that two-step authentication works on one important account and that your recovery method is current.

title: Give the Task Five Minutes
teaser: A tiny start can test whether resistance is bigger than the work itself.
message: Spend five minutes on something you have delayed and decide what to do next only after starting.

title: Confirm a Date at the Source
teaser: One wrong date can distort an entire plan.
message: Recheck one important deadline appointment or renewal against the original source today.

title: Ask Instead of Assuming Needs
teaser: Good intentions do not guarantee accurate guesses.
message: Ask someone what would actually help them instead of deciding on their behalf.

title: Create a Short Screen-Free Window
teaser: Continuous input can make real rest harder to notice.
message: Spend at least ten minutes today without a phone tablet or computer in front of you.

title: Make a Habit Cue Visible
teaser: Visible prompts can reduce reliance on memory.
message: Place one clear cue where it will naturally remind you of a habit you want to keep.

title: Count the Fixed Commitments First
teaser: Knowing the nonnegotiable part of a budget improves every later choice.
message: List this month's fixed expenses in one place and look at the total.

title: Define What Accepted Means
teaser: A request stays ambiguous when success has no shared definition.
message: For one task you assign today state the condition that will make it complete.

title: Change the System After the Mistake
teaser: Learning becomes more durable when the environment changes too.
message: Add one small guardrail checklist item or default that reduces the chance of repeating a recent mistake.

title: Name the Opportunity Cost
teaser: Money spent in one place cannot serve another priority.
message: Before one meaningful purchase write what else the same amount could fund.

title: Clear the Digital Desktop
teaser: Visual clutter can slow down retrieval and attention.
message: Move or remove unnecessary files and shortcuts from your computer desktop today.

title: Choose the Success Measure in Advance
teaser: Evaluation is fairer when the rule is set before the result is known.
message: Write the success criterion for one decision before you act on it.

title: Do One Useful Thing Quietly
teaser: Helpful actions do not need recognition to have value.
message: Make one person's day easier in a small way without turning it into a performance.

title: Review Active Sessions
teaser: Old sign-ins can remain open long after they are needed.
message: Check the active devices or sessions on one important account and close anything unfamiliar or obsolete.

title: Give a Project a Stop Rule
teaser: Continuing forever is not always evidence of commitment.
message: Define one condition that would justify pausing or ending a project you are currently carrying.

title: Pair a Percentage With the Count
teaser: Percentages are easier to interpret when the underlying sample is visible.
message: For one important percentage find the actual number of records people or events behind it.

title: Give Shared Work One Clear Owner
teaser: Tasks can disappear when responsibility is spread too widely.
message: Name one primary owner for a shared task and separate that role from the people who support it.

title: Set a Ceiling for One Spending Category
teaser: Predefined limits reduce repeated decision-making.
message: Choose a reasonable cap for one discretionary category through the end of the month.

title: Let a Fresh Pair of Eyes Test It
teaser: Familiarity can hide friction from the person who built something.
message: Ask someone with little context to try one document screen or process and note where they hesitate.

title: Find Files With Unclear Age
teaser: Unknown freshness makes information harder to trust.
message: Scan one important folder for files whose dates or versions are unclear and label what needs attention.

title: Match Light Tasks to Low-Energy Hours
teaser: Not every useful task requires peak concentration.
message: Write three simple tasks that fit the part of your day when your energy is usually lower.

title: Close One Promise Loop
teaser: Small unresolved commitments still occupy attention.
message: Finish one minor promise you made earlier or communicate a new realistic date for it.

title: Close May With Evidence
teaser: A useful review compares memory with something observable.
message: Look at one concrete measure from May such as time money or completed output and use it to shape one June decision.
